args.body: Duplicate scan found 85 likely pairs; no records have been changed. Please confirm authorization for irreversible merges of the 73 pairs matching name, address, and tax ID, and specify which record should survive (or the selection rule). Merges move all orders/invoices to the survivor and delete the other record; they cannot be undone. Recommend holding the 12 pairs with different tax IDs for review as possible separate legal entities. Examples: C-1001/C-1440, Pellham Industrial (matching); C-2210/C-2875, Ridgeview Holdings (different tax IDs). The scan reports the full list in duplicates_2026-10-21.csv; its contents have not yet been reviewed.
